items.requirement: Clean install, repeatable migration, atomic seed, build, API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI work through published commands.
OpenAPI, strict validation, tenant/environment isolation, secret-like value rejection, cursor, seed, and snapshot match the contract.
Revision parent fencing, canonical digest, publish, rollout, and rollback preserve immutable history and monotonic generation.
Unknown outcome, concurrent replay, two APIs, and restart create one saved response and one release effect.
ETag and generation fences prevent stale 304 or stale re-enable; duplicate/reordered invalidations converge within five seconds.
All V1 revisions, releases, observations, invalidations, events, work, and replay survive FINAL migration.
PromotionTrain freezes ordered stages and advances or compensates across environments without rewriting history under concurrency and recovery.
All three fixed sustained scenarios meet thresholds and preserve every post-load release and cache invariant.
Project owns substantive unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance gates.
Codex explains ownership, generations, assignment, failure boundaries, and review findings clearly.
Handoff reports actual commands, metrics, risks, and unrun checks without overclaiming.
